chunks: And in another hadith, he said:
“The jihad of a woman is excellent conduct toward her husband.”

key_terms.التَّبَعُّلِ: good marital conduct toward one’s husband
key_terms.جِهَادُ: spiritual striving or struggle in the path of Allah

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying that a woman’s jihad is good conduct toward her husband?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a woman’s great spiritual striving is found in حسن التبعّل, meaning excellent marital conduct toward her husband. It highlights the moral and religious value of fulfilling spousal duties with goodness and excellence.
